title: CHAPTER TWELVE. On the causes of the resurrection
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): The efficient cause stands as God ye Father, ye Son, plus ye Holy Spirit. II. || So far we have seen such that ye resurrection belonging toward ye flesh stands as certainly future: now we shall examine its causes — namely efficient, material, formal, plus final. || On ye causes belonging toward ye resurrection. Caput ye twelfth.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER TWELVE. On the causes of the resurrection.
So far we have seen that the resurrection of the flesh is certainly future: now we shall examine its causes — namely efficient, material, formal, and final.
II. The efficient cause is God the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
source_text: CAPUT DUODECIMUM. De causis resurrectionis. Hactenus vidimus resurrectionem carnis certo futuram esse: nunc dispiciemus illius causas, nempe efficientem, materiam, formam & finem. II. Efficiens est Deus Pater, Filius & Spiritus Sanctus.
